stories.title: Ozon evacuates more than 500 staff amid drone attack on its warehouse in Samara Region
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 22. More than 500 employees have been evacuated from a fire at an Ozon warehouse in the Samara Region, the e-commerce retailer said on its Max channel. "Today, an Ozon logistics center in the Samara Region came under a drone attack. A fire ensued as a result of the attack. <…> We have evacuated more than 500 employees within minutes. However, unfortunately, there were victims," the post reads. Several people were injured in a massive drone attack on the Samara Region, Governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev reported via Max channel earlier.
